title: Unique injective CE resolutions of upper smart truncations
statement: Let A,B be abelian, B Grothendieck abelian, F:A to B additive, and P a CE presentation [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Put K=F(P.J), extended by zero. For every integer q, horizontal smart truncation I_q=truncLE(P.I,q) has a unique augmentation from single-zero(truncLE(K,q)) commuting with the truncation inclusions. Its unflipped, zero-extended total has a unique augmentation specified on the resolution-degree-zero summands, which is a quasi-isomorphism. Both augmentation maps commute with every CE presentation comparison. The total vanishes below zero, has injective terms, and is K-injective [def-sp-kinjective-bridge]. The uniqueness includes the augmentation square and total coordinates, rather than choosing an arbitrary resolution witness.

proof.text: An exact additive functor commutes with upper smart truncation: below q use the ordinary coordinate isomorphisms; at q use preservation of cycles; above q both sides are zero. Cancel the monic truncation inclusion to prove the differential equation. Specialize to the exact single-zero functor.

The horizontally truncated CE rows are the original rows below q, the horizontal cycle row at q, and zero above q. The CE term and cycle hypotheses prove rowwise injectivity and quasi-isomorphism. Smart truncation preserves negative vanishing.

Apply the proved bounded-below augmented-total theorem to obtain the augmentation, its coordinate formula, quasi-isomorphism, and K-injectivity. Independently use the finite diagonal coproduct to exhibit injectivity of every total term and vanishing below zero. Compose with the Mathlib total flip isomorphism to restore the unflipped total convention; its degree-zero resolution sign is one.

Cancel the monic truncation inclusion to prove uniqueness of the bicomplex augmentation. Degreewise extensionality and the total coordinate equation prove uniqueness of the total augmentation. A CE comparison commutes with the original augmentation in every degree because positive resolution degrees of its source vanish. Cancel the monic truncation inclusion for the truncated square. Total-summand naturality and the augmentation coordinates then prove the total square.

theorem cartanEilenberg_truncation_resolution [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    (P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (q : ℤ) :
    let K := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (P.J.cocomplex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    let I := CochainComplex.truncLE P.I q
    let T := (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).obj I
    ∃! a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (CochainComplex.truncLE K q) ⟶ I,
      a ≫ CochainComplex.ιTruncLE P.I q =
        ((CochainComplex.single₀ B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE K q) ≫ P.e ∧
      ∃! aug : CochainComplex.truncLE K q ⟶ T.total (.up ℤ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, aug.f n = (a.f n).f 0 ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
            (((𝟭 B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj (I.X n))
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
          T.ιTotal (.up ℤ) n 0 n (add_zero n)) ∧
        QuasiIso aug ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Injective ((T.total (.up ℤ)).X n)) ∧
        CochainComplex.IsStrictlyGE (T.total (.up ℤ)) 0 ∧
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective (T.total (.up ℤ)) ∧
        ∀ (Q : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (d : P.Comparison Q),
          let KQ := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (Q.J.cocomplex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
          let IQ := CochainComplex.truncLE Q.I q
          let TQ := (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).obj IQ
          let k := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap d.β ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
          let u := CochainComplex.truncLEMap d.α q
          ∀ (aQ : ((CochainComplex.single₀ B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (CochainComplex.truncLE KQ q) ⟶ IQ),
            aQ ≫ CochainComplex.ιTruncLE Q.I q =
              ((CochainComplex.single₀ B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
                (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE KQ q) ≫ Q.e →
            ∀ (augQ : CochainComplex.truncLE KQ q ⟶ TQ.total (.up ℤ)),
              (∀ n : ℤ, augQ.f n = (aQ.f n).f 0 ≫
                (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
                  (((𝟭 B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj (IQ.X n))
                  ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
                TQ.ιTotal (.up ℤ) n 0 n (add_zero n)) →
              a ≫ u = ((CochainComplex.single₀ B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
                  (CochainComplex.truncLEMap k q) ≫ aQ ∧
                aug ≫ HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
                    ((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).map u) (.up ℤ) =
                  CochainComplex.truncLEMap k q ≫ augQ
